blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY—Online threats gripping schools in Sta. Margarita, Samar, are unsubstantiated, police said, as school officials assured parents and students that classes would continue amid school security concerns. In a statement, the Sta. Margarita Municipal Police Station said it conducted verification, investigation, and cyber-monitoring activities after online messages threatening schools in the municipality circulated on Monday, raising alarm among students, parents, teachers, and the community. Police said it has identified the individual associated with the account that posted the threats and is undergoing appropriate intervention through the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office.
